consequence.statement: Policy exceptions are now disabled by default and are only allowed in a specified namespace. Setups that relied on exceptions in all namespaces change behavior unless the upgrade guidance is followed.
consequence.remediation: Follow the upgrade guidance to keep backward compatibility.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes the defaults so policy exceptions are disabled and can only be created in a specified namespace, where earlier versions allowed them in all namespaces.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The text does not name the setting, flag or values key that controls exceptions. It only refers to the upgrade guidance, so no predicate can be written.
